# bintables/call

> Call: push arguments right to left, call, then pop them.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/call.pkg) · translates [std/call](../std/call.md)

Arguments are evaluated and pushed from last to first, so parameter *i* ends
up at `[rbp+16+8i]` in the callee. Calls without arguments skip the
`add rsp` cleanup (`when args empty`).

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when args empty`

```nasm
call {callee.label}
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
call {callee.label}
add rsp, {args.size}
```
